prompt: Create ONE production game sprite atlas of four reusable papercraft board-game components in a precisely spaced 2 by 2 grid on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. The supplied image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its intricate black ink engraving, ivory paper fibers, corrugated cardboard edges, handmade gothic architecture, warm charcoal shadow, matte layered cardboard, and restrained original fairytale style. Each quadrant is a separate isolated complete object with generous transparent margins and no contact with its neighbors. Top left: a single low round / gently octagonal stepping-stone island, viewed from 40 degrees above; broad EMPTY ivory top face for a number to be added by code, thin layered beveled paper sides, tiny dark cracks and weathered edges; nearly twice as wide as deep, no symbols or writing. Top right: one short vertical rope-and-wood ladder, shown straight from above with slight perspective, eight robust ivory wooden/paper rungs and braided charcoal rails, handmade attachments at each end, vertical long axis aligned exactly top-to-bottom, no platform behind it. Bottom left: one short straight vertical open gothic stone water chute / slide, empty deep slate trough in the middle, raised ivory carved-paper sidewalls, folded paper end lip, drawn from above at a slight angle, top-to-bottom axis, no water splashes, no background. Bottom right: one small freestanding ivory gothic archway with a warm pearl lantern hanging inside, standing on a small rocky paper plinth. Consistent illumination from upper left, consistent scale and stroke weight. Keep silhouette readable when reduced to small game pieces. NO text, NO labels, NO numbers, NO arrows, NO roads, NO colored pastel outlines, NO grid lines, NO backdrop, NO glow cloud. True transparent alpha around all four components. Square high-resolution atlas.
